Invoices.telegram_hub_subtitle: Send invoices to tenants on Telegram. The numbers below count the invoices currently listed.
Invoices.bot_not_reachable: Connection failed. Check the bot configuration.
Invoices.connecting_a_tenant: How to set up the Telegram Bot?
Invoices.connect_step_1: Search for @BotFather in Telegram and send "/newbot" to generate your Bot Agent.
Invoices.connect_step_2: Set the token as TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in your server's environment variables (see .env.example).
Invoices.connect_step_3: Ask tenants to find their unique Chat ID via @CheckMyIDBot and save it onto their profile page.
Invoices.staff_persona_limit_msg: Your profile limits payments logging. You can generate auto invoices and record readings.

Invoices.generate_dialog_desc: Choose the billing period. One invoice is created per active lease that doesn't already have one for this period.

Invoices.auto_send_help: The server sends a short invoice summary to every tenant who connected Telegram (and allows auto-send) — even when nobody has the app open. Use the button below to send the full invoice image.
Invoices.automation_desc: Runs on the server every 30 minutes.
